name: Nadreck
source:
Member of "The Six". Has the ability to apport and asport animate and inanimate objects (essentially instantaneous teleportation of objects to a definitive target he can visualise, objects subject to his powers ignore all obstacles and manifest directly at the destination).

The youngest of the Six, he argues frequently with Worsel but otherwise gets along well with the other members. 

Uses a vast quantity of Kunai which are used as instantaneous projectiles. He is unable to run out of ammunition since the weapons are not held on his person. 

[Spoiler] Real name 阿文, the older of a pair of siblings living in San Francisco's Chinatown who were targeted for their psionics potential. Kinnison is aware of his background and does not admonish him when Nadreck deserts his comrades to look for his sister. 

Nadreck either dies with his goal of reunion with his sister unfulfilled or survives to fight alongside her as the pair vow never to be separated again. [/Spoiler]
